name: Gerchberg-Saxton Algorithm
definition: An iterative optimization method to find object point phase values (ϕo) that cause interference resulting in constant amplitude across the hologram H, solving the problem of phase-only display constraints.
summary: The Gerchberg-Saxton Algorithm is an iterative method for computing phase-only holograms by alternating between object and hologram planes to enforce amplitude constraints, distinguishing itself from gradient-based or learned models.
